answer: One concrete mechanism: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The violet of work and the harbor of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a bridge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
